title: Trade intent poll envelope (trade-intents/1)
description: Response of `GET /api/trade_intents?after=<cursor>&mode=<mode>` (operator token). Pending, unexpired intents oldest-first plus a control block. The agent stops accepting when circuit_breaker.tripped is true, intake_enabled is false, or server_time skews more than its configured limit from its own clock.

cursor.description: Opaque. Pass back as `after` on the next poll; only intents after it are returned.

intents.description: Each item is a trade-intent/1 object; validate it against trade-intent-1.schema.json (no cross-file $ref, so every validator stays standalone).

intake_enabled.description: True only while Rails runs with execution.engine = agent.
